sections.heading: Verdict shape for Clay
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Yes for teams where GTM engineers and RevOps teams building multi-provider enrichment waterfalls matter more than polish elsewhere. Counter-signal: No when Compare Apollo for all-in-one data+sequences, Clearbit/Breeze for HubSpot-native enrichment, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Seamless.AI for simpler high-volume contact search..

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: HubSpot, Salesforce.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Launch, Growth, Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who Clay is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Clay when multi-provider enrichment waterfalls and AI research workflows are the primary job and you have GTM/RevOps capacity to operate them..

Avoid if: Compare Apollo for all-in-one data+sequences, Clearbit/Breeze for HubSpot-native enrichment, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Seamless.AI for simpler high-volume contact search..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Apollo.io on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Clay price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Launch.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
